title: 20/20 Free Public Data Catalog
description: High-value official datasets and metric recipes for future normalized ingestion. Catalog entries do not automatically change rankings.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR APIs
sources.coverage: Public-company submissions, XBRL company facts, filing history, and comparable financial statement concepts.
sources.caveats: Requires CIK normalization, SEC request etiquette, fiscal-period discipline, and careful handling of company-specific custom tags.

sources.name: U.S. Census developer datasets
sources.coverage: ACS, QWI, PSEO, Economic Census, business dynamics, housing, migration, demographics, and public finance.
sources.caveats: Geographic coverage and release years differ by program; preserve geography and survey vintage.

sources.name: BLS public data
sources.coverage: CPI, PPI, employment, wages, productivity, JOLTS, QCEW, occupational employment, and projections.
sources.caveats: Industry and occupation series require crosswalks; avoid mixing seasonally adjusted and unadjusted series.

sources.name: BEA Data API
sources.coverage: GDP by industry, input-output tables, regional GDP/employment, international transactions, and multinational activity.
sources.caveats: Free registration is required; store the key server-side and preserve release vintage.

sources.name: EIA Open Data
sources.coverage: Electricity, fuels, generation, capacity, prices, production, reserves, trade, consumption, and emissions.
sources.caveats: Free API key registration is required; units and revisions vary by series.

sources.name: CMS Data
sources.coverage: Provider enrollment, utilization, payments, beneficiaries, quality of care, prescriptions, and facility data.
sources.caveats: Dataset definitions and reporting periods differ; provider identifiers and measure specifications must be preserved.

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov API
sources.coverage: Study status, phase, enrollment, sponsor, intervention, condition, geography, outcomes, and results posting.
sources.caveats: Registered studies are not equivalent to successful products; separate trials, arms, and posted results.

sources.name: openFDA API
sources.coverage: Drug, device, food and adverse-event, label, recall, and enforcement records.
sources.caveats: FDA warns that not all openFDA data are validated for clinical or production use; use as a signal layer.

sources.name: CFPB Consumer Complaint Database
sources.coverage: Consumer complaints by financial product, issue, company, geography, and company response.
metrics: complaints per customer or market share
sources.caveats: Not a representative statistical sample; normalize by company scale and do not equate complaint volume with harm rate.

sources.name: World Bank Open Data
sources.coverage: Global development indicators for people, prosperity, planet, infrastructure, and digital transformation.
sources.caveats: Country, year, indicator definition, and revision metadata are essential for comparisons.

sources.name: FRED Economic Data
sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
sources.coverage: Macroeconomic, financial, labor, housing, price, and market series from many publishers.
sources.caveats: Record the underlying source, release, observation vintage, units, and revision history.

sources.name: Bureau of Transportation Statistics
sources.coverage: Freight, aviation, transit, vehicles, border crossings, employment, safety, reliability, and transportation economics.
sources.caveats: Mode, geography, and reporting lag differ; distinguish traffic, revenue, volume, and reliability measures.

sources.name: USDA Economic Research Service and NASS
sources.coverage: Agricultural production, commodity prices, farm income, food prices, land use, trade, and rural economics.
sources.caveats: NASS Quick Stats API access may require a free key; bulk tables and ERS products remain publicly available.

sources.name: NOAA Climate Data Online
sources.coverage: Weather, climate normals, extremes, hazards, stations, and environmental observations.
sources.caveats: Station coverage and API token rules vary; use geography and measurement definitions explicitly.

sources.name: USAspending.gov
sources.coverage: Federal contracts, grants, loans, obligations, agencies, recipients, and award geography.
sources.caveats: Obligations are not revenue or profit; distinguish award type, fiscal year, agency, and recipient entity.

sources.name: EPA Envirofacts
sources.coverage: Environmental permits, emissions, facility compliance, toxic releases, and regulated-site records.
sources.caveats: Facility reporting and enforcement records are not a complete measure of environmental impact or liability.

sources.name: USPTO PatentsView
sources.coverage: Patent documents, inventors, assignees, technology classifications, citations, and innovation networks.
sources.caveats: Patent quantity is an innovation activity proxy, not proof of commercial value or defensibility.
